WITH matched AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), combinations AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
), with_fractions AS (
  SELECT translink,
         ordertypedist,
         record_count,
         CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_type_total
  FROM combinations
)
SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count, fraction_of_type_total
FROM with_fractions
ORDER BY fraction_of_type_total DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row contributes one matched record per matching transactionrecord row; the primary key on transreg makes that match unique.
